notices: Interviews only today. The schedule follows the supplied Day 3 call sheet for Wednesday 11 November 2026. All times are local. Day 2 remains separately selectable for reference.

Crew call is 10:20 in the Hotel Diego de Velázquez lobby. Have equipment ready to load so the van can leave promptly. The call sheet allows about 20–25 minutes to Estadio Croata; check live traffic with the driver before departure.
Arrival at Estadio Croata is 10:45, leaving 15 minutes before Guillermo’s 11:00 interview. Prioritize sound, two-camera setup and the contributor.

Lunch is 13:00–14:30. Leave at 14:30 for the Los Leones area. The call sheet allows 20–25 minutes driving, with 15:00 arrival/setup and a 15:30 interview start. These are call-sheet allowances, not measured live journey times.
Goran works from conversation without a fixed questionnaire. Guillermo is a professor, lawyer and writer; Davor is a journalist in the TVN News Department.
17:30 is the estimated wrap and start of the return, not hotel arrival. Pack and load before departure.

The private interview address, apartment details and production phone numbers remain in the crew call sheet. There is no home pin or public navigation to it. The driver uses the private call sheet for the afternoon arrival and pickup.
Route links are for known public destinations. Checklists save only on this device and do not sync between crew members.
